$unification_2026_08_05.summary: Collapsed THREE competing Apollo+ shells into one. This chapter was written 2026-07-28, before apollo_plus_open() existed, so it documented only the trait path — the divergence grew underneath it.

the_three_shells_found.A_trait: BlankCanvasTrait::render_blank_canvas_plus() → template hand-rolls apollo_render_document_open() + <body class="ax-body"> + apollo_render_app_shell() + apollo-events LOCAL template-parts/shared/{topbar,overlay,panels,aside}.php + <div class="ax-shell"> + <main class="ax-main">. Used by create-event.php, dashboard-event.php.
the_three_shells_found.B_plus_api: apollo_plus_open()/apollo_plus_close() (apollo-templates/includes/apollo-plus-api.php) → head + topbar-styles + app_shell + apollo-plus/aside.php + <main class="ax-main" id="axMain"> + <body class="ax-shell">. Used by every phase-001..010 screen.

why_it_mattered: DIFFERENT ASIDE: path A rendered apollo-events' own shared/aside.php, which has no gestor group — so Meus eventos / Meus anúncios / Minhas Comunas / Meus Núcleos / Meus projetos / Minhas tarefas simply did not exist on /novo-evento or /meus-eventos. Walking /eventos/meus → /novo-evento swapped the sidebar out from under the user.

DIFFERENT .ax-main GEOMETRY: shell-styles.php declares .ax-main{padding:50px 30px 180px;max-width:1040px}; aside-styles.php declares .ax-main{padding:0;width:100%;max-width:none} plus the >=1000px pinned-aside offsets. Two owners of one selector, opposite intents, winner decided by load order — the exact failure CLAUDE.md calls the cardinal sin.

DIFFERENT TOPBAR CSS SOURCE, so the two shells drifted independently. This is also why the topbar was completely unstyled on every path-B screen until 2026-07-30 (apollo_plus_open never loaded any topbar CSS at all).
Mixing A and B on one request emits two <head>/<body> pairs — already documented as a live failure in comunas.php, apollo-events Plugin.php and apollo-adverts Plugin.php.

resolution.canonical: apollo_plus_open() / apollo_plus_close() is now THE Apollo+ shell. One head, one topbar, one aside, one <main>, one CSS source.
resolution.api_extended: apollo_plus_open() gained `theme` and `html_class` (additive, defaults reproduce prior output byte for byte) so the legacy documents could convert without losing the dark + is-logged treatment they already had.
resolution.guard_added: apollo-events/styles/base/template-parts/shared/shell-styles.php now wraps its SHELL FRAME block (.ax-top*, .ax-aside, .ax-main, .panel-r, .apps-pop) in `if (! defined(APOLLO_PLUS_TOPBAR_STYLES))`. Kept, not deleted — it is still the shell for a consumer running without apollo-templates. Its component layer (buttons, cards, .field-input, .as2 combobox) stays unconditional because the forms depend on it and it collides with nothing. This makes the unification self-enforcing rather than a one-off cleanup.

still_open: Path C (apollo_render_blank_canvas_body) survives in apollo-users/templates/user-radar.php — not converted this pass, not verified.
apollo-dashboard/includes/class-plugin.php:207 still calls render_blank_canvas_plus() — works, but inherits whatever shell its template hand-rolls. Audit before trusting.

apollo-events shared/{topbar,overlay,panels,aside}.php are now unreferenced by the two converted templates. Left on disk deliberately (rollback + non-apollo-templates fallback); delete only after path A is fully retired.

$blocks_vs_shells_2026_08_08.why_this_note_exists: $unification_2026_08_05 above is a record of three things that each thought they were the shell. The next reusable piece of Apollo+ chrome landed three days later, so the distinction is worth stating once rather than rediscovering it.
$blocks_vs_shells_2026_08_08.rule: A SHELL owns the document: <head>, <body>, topbar, aside, <main>. There is exactly one, apollo_plus_open()/apollo_plus_close(). A BLOCK owns a band inside <main>: it emits no document furniture, calls no shell function, and is included with apollo_plus_part() like any other part. Blocks are unlimited; shells are one.
$blocks_vs_shells_2026_08_08.first_block: apollo_listing_header() (apollo-templates 1.5.1, includes/listing-header-api.php) — the month/search/filter band for archive screens. Documented in 09-plugins/apollo-templates.json $listing_header_block_2026_08_08; first mounted on /eventos, see 09-plugins/apollo-events.json $portal_header_swap_2026_08_08.
$blocks_vs_shells_2026_08_08.where_a_new_block_goes: apollo-templates/templates/template-parts/{block}/, with its public API in apollo-templates/includes/{block}-api.php — the same place and shape as the shell parts, so apollo_plus_part()'s child-theme → parent-theme → plugin override chain applies to it for free.
